lines: Is there anything left that love can do?
I was born into this world with nothing at all
Writhe as I might in eternity's gap
Only those who gave up and those who got wise
In this age of winners, where do they draw breath?
Rulers and gods alike wear the face of strangers
But deep down, we should already know
The magic of courage, hope, and bonds
Useless now, grown-ups look away
And still, the you of that day, even now
Stands at the very center of all my justice
Even when the whole world turns its back
You who stand and fight are here, even now
Is there anything left that love can do?
Is there anything left that I can do?
The courage you gave me
I want to use it for you
The love we shared together
It means nothing unless it's with you
Is there anything left that love can do?
Is there anything left that I can do?
Fate is just the roll of a die
Or maybe God's usual whim
Chosen and choosing, armor we can't take off
Or else a distant will that never wavers
Unfulfilled wishes, reunions that never come
Misunderstandings that won't untangle, hatred piling up
Voices forgiving, hands clasped tight
This planet carries them all and lives on, today again
Is there anything left that love can do?
Is there anything left that I can do?
The courage you gave me
I want to use it for you
The love we raised together
It means nothing unless it's with you
Is there anything left that love can do?
Is there anything left that I can do?
Why did you let us, who have nothing, dream?
Why did you give hope to a life that ends?
Why give us only things that slip through these hands?
Are we ugly, still clinging on even so?
Or are we beautiful?
Answer me
Every song of love has been sung to its end
Told to their limits in countless films
You and I were born into just such a wasteland
And still
There is something left that love can do
There is something left that I can do
